name: uk-fca-aml
display_name: UK FCA AML / Financial Crime Rules — Post-Brexit
description: Structured knowledge graph for UK financial crime prevention requirements post-Brexit. Covers FCA's SYSC 6.3 (financial crime), the Money Laundering Regulations 2017 (as amended), Proceeds of Crime Act 2002 (POCA), Terrorism Act 2000, JMLSG Guidance, FCA Financial Crime Guide (FCG), FCA Dear CEO letters, HM Treasury AML/CFT National Risk Assessment, and UK Sanctions (OFSI). Includes post-Brexit divergence points from EU AMLR/AMLD framework.
author: Futurechain FCP Team
